description.value: Sammy J's Grill & Bar is a BC-grown casual restaurant chain founded in Langley City in 1996, now with four locations including this South Surrey outpost. The menu leans American grill — steaks, pastas, thin-crust pizzas, and a well-stocked bar centered on a signature wraparound 'Rock' bar — alongside dedicated vegetarian, vegan-friendly, and gluten-free sections. A touring cyclist can fuel up with a full sit-down meal or order pickup for the road.
